text:
Good morning,

I am pleased to be inquiring about the availability of the 1975 Orsini Veloce for my sister's upcoming wedding day. Our intention is to collect the vehicle from your garage on 11th April 2027 at 13:00 and return it by Tuesday 13 April 2027 at 18:00. Please note that your confirmation of this arrangement would be greatly appreciated. I have also attached a scan of my driving licence for your reference.

Thanks,
Hugo Larkmoor
